The key is waiting in Sector A.Set it up your way From super cozy to nearly impossible: every challenge can be adjusted to how you like to play. events.title: The You're Nuts! demo is out now, plus a Friend's Pass reveal
events.summary: Our tiny robots have woken up, and they want out. The free demo of You're Nuts! is out now on Steam, so grab some friends (or go solo) and start your escape! What is You're Nuts!?Think Maze Runner, but you puzzle your way out. You're self-aware robots locked in an abandoned factory, and the only way to escape is to solve your way through a maze full of puzzles.Every day you head out, crack puzzles that open the way forward and grab loot, always with one eye on your battery. events.title: Playtest Sign-Ups Are Open
events.summary: Hey everyone!We’re thrilled to announce that the You’re Nuts! Steam Playtest sign-ups are now live!What is You’re Nuts!?A cozy 1–4 player co-op puzzle escape adventure. You play as sentient robots who’ve awakened inside a silent, decaying factory. Your mission: solve puzzles, scavenge parts, craft upgrades, and find the exit — all before the day ends and you’re forced back to your hub.What does signing up mean?By clicking "Request Access" on the store page, you’re joining the playtest list.
